content:
marta: Pushed a new draft focused on clarity and demo allocation fairness: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/fairness-draft. Asking for quick checks: benchmark phrasing, CTA microcopy, and the demo allocation rules in the FAQ.

alex: Nice framing. Benchmarks need run link if we keep exact numbers. Recommend a range to be safe.

sam: Proposed sentence: "In mixed chat + long-context tests (avg conv ~700 tokens), Redwood reduced per-token compute by approximately 2525% vs baseline (see run_2026_03_30_v2, s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/30/run_v2/metrics.csv)."

kasia: Good. Keep the range. Add one-line about methodology: hardware parity and normalized per-token compute. I'll sign off once CSV is attached and claim checklist is filled.

jennI: Webinar info to include: Thu 2026-04-09 11:00 PT, cap 280. Ops reserved 60 demo seats. Demand gen request: enterprise leads get priority allocation window for 36 hours after publish. Need that spelled out in FAQ.

oliver: Ops can do priority window. Please paste HubSpot form id + property so I can run webhook tests. Also, call the feature "demo seat allocation" to be clear to engineering.

sam: HubSpot snippet to drop in Integration appendix:
```hubspot_form_id: hs_110011
properties:
  email: contact.email
  company: contact.company
  lead_tier: single_select (enterprise,startup,other)
  campaign: launch_fairness_apr2026
webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/launch-fairness-2026
```

privacy-bot: auto-scan: collected fields are email and company only. Reminder: include retention period and EU routing if publishing to EU audience.

marta: CTA copy variants I tried: A) "Register to see the launch and request a demo" B) "Save your spot + request a demo seat" C) "Join the launch — demo seats limited" Which works?

alex: Prefer A for clarity. Add microcopy under CTA: "Requesting a demo does not guarantee a seat; enterprise leads in the priority window are favored."

kasia: Legal asks to add the EU routing sentence: "EU leads are routed to our EU HubSpot instance." Also include retention: "contact data retained for up to 18 months (subject to Privacy confirmation)."

jennI: Timeline: editorial and ops sign-off by Fri EOD, legal by Mon noon, privacy by Mon 3pm, publish Wed morning. Can team ack?

oliver: Ack 2: will run webhook + seat-assignment test tomorrow and paste trace.

sam: Ack 2: will update benchmark line in the draft now.

kasia: Ack 2: will complete claim checklist and chase Privacy on retention.

marta: Thanks everyone. I'll fold these changes and lock the draft when legal confirms wording. Ping here for final thumbs.
